title: Console: creating a record page adds it as a top-level navigation entry to every app, and the write into a sealed managed app fails with a red "Failed to update navigation" toast
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXSZs9PBUc2H8z6mtB

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing point and a reproduction (reach: Studio page creation and publish, network trace, 2 runs).
Business reason: an admin creates a record page (a page that renders one record of an object) in Studio. The console then writes it into the navigation of every app, including apps of other packages. A record page is not navigable on its own, so each app gains a menu entry that opens a page with no record. On the stock showcase, the write into the sealed managed app is refused 403, and the author sees a red error toast on every record page they create. This came with ruling A on #28680 (write navigation at create time, PR #28783). The ruling chose when to write; it did not ask for record pages or sealed apps to be written.
Reader who acts: the ui lane (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavigationSync.ts`). Do not sync a page whose type needs a record (`record`, and any other non-navigable type). Treat an app the server seals as a managed-package item as not syncable, as `isNavigationSyncableApp` already does for `_lock` full / no-overlay.
Dedupe: `"Failed to update navigation"` 0 hits; `useNavigationSync` 8 (#28680 [Decision] closed, the ruling; #28645 closed, its parent; #19049, #20290, #23254 closed, other shapes); `navigation sync record page` 117 (run records and phone-width cards). No card covers it.

QA-source: #29172 · studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

Creating and publishing a record page sends, after the publish, one app PUT per app. Each appends `{type:'page', pageName:'NAME'}` to that app's navigation:
- `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/rthree_app` (a scratch package's app) → 200. The record page is now a top-level entry there.
- `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/showcase_app` → **403** `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` ("provided by a managed package and is sealed").

Toasts: "Navigation updated: added page …" and "Failed to update navigation".

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02) on a stock showcase boot with one scratch package installed, Console built from the same tree.

## Reproduction

1. Showcase boot, signed in as admin. Optionally install a scratch package with its own app so you can see both outcomes.
2. Open `/_console/studio/~all/metadata/page/new`. Enter Label "R3 Nav Probe Page", Page type `record`, Object `showcase_task`. Save, then Publish.
3. Network: `POST /api/v1/meta/page/r3_nav_probe_page/publish` → 200, then the app PUTs above.
4. **Expected:** a record page is not added to any app's navigation. No write is attempted into an app the server seals.
5. **Actual:** it is appended to every writable app's navigation, and the sealed app's refusal surfaces as an error toast.

Reproduced 2/2 (`invoice_page_r3a` on `showcase_contact`, `r3_nav_probe_page` on `showcase_task`).

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavigationSync.ts`, `useNavigationWrites().created` (around L655), calls `syncPageCreatedAllApps(name)` for every created `page`, whatever the page's own `type`.
- `isNavigationSyncableApp` (around L205) skips only apps whose `_lock` / `protection.lock` is `full` or `no-overlay`. It does not skip an app the server refuses as a sealed managed-package item (`NOT_OVERRIDABLE`). Its own comment says such attempts "surfaced as a red 'Failed to update navigation' toast" and should not be made.
